key_points.point: 195 14 ― Economic Activities Around Us CHAPTER 14 Monetary value: Value of something that can be measured in terms of money.
Economic Activities Around Us The root of prosperity is economic activity, the lack of it brings material distress.

The absence of fruitful economic activity endangers both current prosperity and future growth. — Kauṭilya’s Arthaśhāstra Introduction In Chapter 13, we learnt about two types of activities – economic and non- economic.
Activities that create monetary value are called economic activities.
We also learnt about the importance of non-economic activities.
To understand these activities better we will learn how economic activities are classified and what differentiates them in this chapter.
What differentiates these activities to be grouped into sectors?
